༄༅/ /slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa blo gsal nyer mkho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa blo gsal nyer mkho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig bsten na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub ma lus myur du stsol mdzad pa/ /phongs pa kun skyobs rje btsun sgrol ma la/ /nye bar btud nas de yi rjes gnang bri/ /'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs mtho bar stan khebs kyis bkab pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar maṇḍal dri bzang gi thig le byugs pa'i steng du 'bras kyi tshom bu/ de'i mdun du dkar gtor rgyan ldan/ de dag gi mdun du sbreng tshar gyi chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ rang mdun du rdor dril me tog gi snod/ slob ma la bkye bsdu'i chas maṇḍal/ me tog dang bcas pa sta gon bya/ rjes gnang sbrel nas byed na du byed kyi grangs kyi tshom bu bkod/ nas 'bras dang 'o ma sbyar ba/ zhal zas gtor ma kha gso ba'i mtheb skyu yang bshams/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po sgrol ma myur zhing dpa' ba'i rjes gnang ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dkrol/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes bdun sogs brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun sgrol ma bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i oṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa'i sgrol ma la/ sgrol ma nyi shu dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥ.arya tā re sa pā ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ ārya tā re sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi dbus su padma ser po dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las sgrol ma rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo me stag 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol ba'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gnyis gnyis na mda' dang gzhu/ gsum pa gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ bzhi pa gnyis dung dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i nyams can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam snang gi dbu brgyan/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du oṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad de/

oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar gong bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa dor/ de nas mchod pa kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ārya tā re arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar mtshan sngags sbyar/ phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ /spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma/ /'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi/ /ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma/ /phyag 'tshal rab tu dpa' ba'i sgrol ma/ /spros med rnam dag nam mkha'i dkyil na/ /padma gser mdog gdan la bzhugs pa'i/ /sku mdog dmar po me yi 'od can/ /phyag 'tshal zhal gcig phyag brgyad spyan rgyas/ /dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang po gnyis ni/ /rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bsnol nas/ /de 'og mda' gzhu thugs kar 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal gsum pas 'khor lo bsnams te/ /bzhi pa shes rab ral gri 'debs tshul/ /g.yon gyi gsum pa thugs kar mdung 'dzin/ /bzhi pa na ni zhags pas brgyan ma/ /zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma la chus bran/ bsangs sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pā ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zhig bya/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ zhes sogs chos bshad rgyas bsdus gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar 'tshams par bshad nas/ da lam 'dir gsan bya chos kyi ngo bo ni rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa dang rjes su mthun par bkral ba rje btsun ma sgrol ma yin zhing / de la yang lugs srol mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa las 'dir skabs su babs pa dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal snga nas legs par bkral ba'i sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la thog mar sgrol ma myur zhi dpa' mo'am rab tu dpa' mo'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ de la yang slob dpon dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bgyi 'os thams cad legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar slob dpon la sgrol ma myur zhi dpa' mo'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig dbul bar zhu/ zhes 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ma nyer gcig gi lha tshogs mngon sum ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la sgrol ma myur zhing dpa' mo'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

lan gsum zhes pa rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi de nyid la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nas oṃ las bar gong gi bdag mdun bzhin khyed rang rnams sgrol ma rab tu dpa' mo sogs nas hūm̐ sngon po bar gong bzhin/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po tā la nas rje btsun ma'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ bar pa mi tshad tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa mtsho chen po la char babs pa'am rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar sib sib gnyis su med par thim nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rol mo dang gu gul gyis bdug cing / yi ge bcu pa'i mthar a be sha ya a a/ zhes yang yang brjod/ des rje btsun ma myur ma dpa' mo'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ rje btsun ma'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ yig gi mthar yi ge bcu pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba la sngags phreng gnyis byung /

slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces yi ge bcu'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de ltar byas pas dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos pa byas nas slob dpon la drin lan du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas dbu gtsug tu gtor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la bgo bar mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni/ /'di la bgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des rje btsun ma myur ma dpa' mo'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byas nas rje btsun ma'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog gnyis ka nas 'od zer gyis lho phyogs po tā la na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul bas de'i thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdor dril/ mda' gzhu/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ dung / zhags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thon khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sib sib thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thugs rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/

sngar ltar dril gsil dang sngags brjod/ des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ rje btsun ma'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rjes gnang sbrel nas byed na/ des dang po myur zhi dpa' mo'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa yin/ zhes brjod nas/ de bar la phyi ma'i lung bklag mchod g.yogs pas mchod pa kha gsos/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod bstod gong bzhin yig brgya lan gsum/ badzra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod nas/ slar yang mchod gtor kha gsos tshom bu gsar pa bkod/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong ltar byas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan re brjod/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes sogs so so'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa cung zad dang bcas pa bya/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ bdag bskyed bzhin yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis phul/ so so'i bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs mtshan sngags a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de bar slob ma rnams kyis phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'don/ de nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ zhes sogs sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ gsan bya chos kyi ngo bo ni/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal snga nas kyis sgrol ma nyer gcig bla med du bkral ba'i nang nas/ gnyis pa dkar mo zla mdangs sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bya ba rnams grub nas/ rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal dbul bar zhu/ zhes phul nas/

gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la dkar mo zla mdangs sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gong du rgyas par bstan pa ltar 'og ma thams cad la rgya 'bag gi mig ltar 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ mjug tu/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi legs par grub nas gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ des slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i zhabs kyis nye bar bkral ba'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig las 'di zhes bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba legs par gsan pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs thams cad la rigs 'gre shes par byas la bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar spyi 'gro'i chings rnams la go ba legs par chags par byas nas/ de nas so so'i mngon rtogs bstan pas shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa dkar mo zla mdangs kyi sgrol ma ni/ pad zla la taṃ yig las rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar sngo ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ dang po gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag g.yas lhag mas kha ṭwāṃ ga 'khor lo/ nor bu/ rdo rje/ me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyis spyi blugs/ utpal/ dril bu/ bum pa/ po ti 'dzin pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu/ /gang ba brgyad gnyis brtsegs pa'i zhal ma/ /skar ma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis/ /rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma/ /phyag 'tshal dkar mo zla mdangs sgrol ma/ /sku gsum rdzogs pa'i zhal gsum g.yon sngo/ /g.yas zhal 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser mdog

/rten 'brel dag pas phyag ni bcu gnyis/ /phyag 'tshal dang po mnyam pa'i phyag rgya/ /gnyis pa na ni kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo gsum pas legs 'dzin/ /bzhi pa na ni yid bzhin nor bu/ /phyag 'tshal lnga pa rdo rje rab 'phyar/ /drug pa na ni me tog phreng 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pas ril ba spyi blugs/ /nyon mongs dri ma ma lus 'khrud ma/ /phyag 'tshal gsum pa utpal legs 'dzin/ /stong pa'i sgra sgrogs bzhi pa dril bu/ /lnga pa gter gyi bum pa thogs ma/ /drug pa po ti 'gro la chos ston/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa sgrol ma gser mdog can ni/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la re las sgrol ma gser mdog can ma zhal gcig phyag bcu ma/ g.yas pa rnams na phreng ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyu gu/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ padma/ dril bu/ gzhu rnams bsnams pa rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin 'byung / bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal gser sngo chu nas skyes kyi/ /padmas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma/ /sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba/ /bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma/ /sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i gdan la/ /rdo rje skyil krung shin tu brjid mdzes/ /phyag bcu pha rol phyin bcu dag ma/ /phyag 'tshal dang po thugs kar phreng 'dzin/ /gnyis pa na ni shes rab ral gri/ /gsum pas mda' 'phen nyon mongs 'bigs ma/ /bzhi pa rdo rje lnga ba dbyug gu/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon gyi dang po dar dpyangs/ /gnyis pa zhags pa gsum pa padma/ /bzhi pa'i phyag gis dril bu 'khrol ma/ /lnga pa na ni snying rje'i gzhu thogs/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrol ma ni/ padma ser po dang zla ba la tuta yig las sgrol ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang phreng ba/ g.yon gaṇḍe dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can no/ /rigs bdag

bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor/ /mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma/ /ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis shin tu bsten ma/ /phyag 'tshal gtsug tor rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ /chu skyes padma ser po'i steng na/ /zag med bde rgyas zla ba'i gdan steng / /sems dpa'i skyil krung brtan par bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal dge ma gser gyi mdog can/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin 'gro la rab brtse/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bdud bzhi rab 'joms/ /g.yas kyi dang po dngos grub mchog stsol/ /phyag 'tshal rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bsam gtan/ /gnyis pa na ni phreng ba 'dzin ma/ /g.yon gyi dang po phyag mtshan gaṇḍe/ /gnyis pa rin chen dbyug gu bsnams ma/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dang zla ba la tā yig las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon padma ser po bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa na/ phyag 'tshal tuttā ra hūm̐ gi yi ge /'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma/ /'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis mnan te/ /lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ /phyag 'tshal hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa'i sgrol ma/ /dri med zla ba'i gdan gyi steng na/ /nyon mongs skyon bral dag pa'i sku mdog /btso ma g.ya' bral gser gyi mdangs ldan/ /phyag 'tshal dpa' mo shes rab bdag nyid/ /thugs rjes 'khor ba zhe la brnag nas/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir hūm̐ gi sgra sgrogs/ /dug gsum srid pa'i g.yul las rgyal ma/ /phyag 'tshal bden gnyis dag pa'i phyag rgya/ /'gro rnams thugs rjes rab tu gzung phyir/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis skyabs sbyin mdzad cing / /g.yon pa padma ser po 'dzin ma/ /zhes so/ /drug pa sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal ma ni/ padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la re las sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje/

gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa/ /rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma/ /'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ /chu skyes padma dmar po'i steng na/ /gti mug dag phyir nyi ma'i gdan steng / /sems dpa'i skyil krung 'gro la gzigs ma/ /phyag 'tshal lha dang drang srong rnams kyis/ /khyed zhabs padmo spyi bor blangs nas/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyod la rab bstod/ /'gro ba kun gyi re gnas gyur ma/ /phyag 'tshal padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang pos/ /rdo rje 'phyar zhing de 'og ral gri/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams ma/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa sgrol ma rgol ba 'joms ma ni/ padma ser po dang nyi ma'i gdan la tu yig las sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo na bza' ser po mnabs pa/ drag mo dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang pos padma la gnas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin chen 'byung ldan/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal trad ces bya dang phaṭa kyis/ /pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs zhabs kyis mnan te/ /me 'bar 'khrugs ma shin tu 'bar ma/ /phyag 'tshal rgol ba 'joms pa'i sgrol ma/ /padma gser dang nyi ma'i gdan ma/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs 'gying bag g.yon brkyangs/ /tshom rngams nag mo khros pa'i bzhin 'phyar/ /phyag 'tshal na bza' gser mdog gos gyon/ /dbu skra gyen brdzes lto 'gros brgyan ste/ /rin chen cod paṇa mkha' la rab 'phyar/ /phyag zhabs rin chen gdub bus brgyan ma/ /phyag 'tshal phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po/

/'khor lo 'dzin cing gnyis pa ral gri/ /skye gnas steng du zhags pa bsnams ma/ /g.yon gyi tha ma sdigs mdzub rab gdengs/ /zhes so/ /brgyad pa dbang mchog ster ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang / zla ba dang / chu srin rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la re las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga dang / nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin dang / gnyis pa gnyis padma dang bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don yod grub pa/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo/ /bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms pa/ /chu skyes zhal ni khro gnyer ldan mdzad/ /dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma/ /phyag 'tshal dbang mchog ster ba'i sgrol ma/ /padma dmar po 'bar ba'i steng na/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir chu srin gdan steng / /skyil krung phyed ma gser gyi mdog can/ /phyag 'tshal khros pa'i gnyer ma dang ldan/ /brjid pa'i sku mdog zhal gcig phyag bzhir/ /g.yas na mya ngan med pa'i yal ga /gnyis pa rin chen bsnams shing mchog stsol/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon gyi dang po padma/ /nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos phyir bsnams/ /g.yon gyi tha ma bum pa legs thogs/ /'gro ba kun la dbang mchog ster ma/ /zhes so/ /dgu pa seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ tāṃ yig ljang gu yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog margad ltar ljang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung zhing 'dab ma snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba/ dbu skra phyed du li ba/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i/ /sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma/ /ma lus phyogs kyis 'khor los brgyan pa'i/ /rang gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma/ /yi ge taṃ las 'khrungs pa'i lha mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ba'i gzugs can/ /skra 'khyil me tog gis brgyan mdzes ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas brkyangs zhabs la g.yon pas/ /thabs dang shes rab mi 'bral ral 'khril/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mtshan pa'i/ /padma zla ba'i steng na bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas pas 'gro la mchog stsol/ /phyag g.yon utpal rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs/ /sngo ljang 'gyings bag padma'i mdog can/ /gzhon nu spyan yang nu ma rgyas ma/ /zhes so/ /bcu pa mya ngan sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang zla ba la sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang a sho ka'i yal ga me tog dmar po can 'dzin pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i/ /dbu brgyan 'od kyi phreng ba spel ma/ /bzhad pa rab bzhad tuttā ra yis/ /bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal mya ngan med pa'i sgrol ma/ /ma chags padma dmar po'i steng na/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhabs kyis mnan te/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs 'gyings bag mdzes ma/ /phyag 'tshal 'jig rten dbang du mdzad pa'i/ /sku mdog padma dmar ba'i 'od ltar/ /bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs tuttā ra yis/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal zhal gcig phyag bzhi bdud 'dul/ /dang po gnyis ni spyi bor thal sbyar/ /g.yas 'og ral gri'i phyag rgya dang ldan/ /g.yon na mya ngan med pa'i yal ga /ces so/ /bcu gcig pa phongs pa sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hā las sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo drag mo'i sku can/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gza' brgyad 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon phongs pa sel ba'i lcags kyu zhags pa dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyangs ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rin 'byung / bstod pa ni/ phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams/ /thams cad 'gugs par nus pa nyid ma/ /khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūm̐ gis/ /phongs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma/ /phyag 'tshal 'gro ba 'gugs pa'i sgrol ma/ /gzi brjid phung po nyi ma'i steng na/ /padma'i steng na rol pas g.yas brkyangs/ /'gyings bag nag mo dbang gi las mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal dpa' mo gyad kyi cha byad/ /mtshan mo'i sprin rum mun pa'i mdog can/ /shin tu 'jigs rungs bdud dpung zil gnon/ /nor gyi char 'bebs phongs pa sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal yi ge hūm̐ gi sbyor bas/ /phyogs mtshams rnams nas gza' chen 'gugs ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas na lcags kyu/ /g.yon na rol pa'i zhags pa bsnams ma/ /ces so/ /bcu gnyis pa bkra shis snang ba'i sgrol ma ni/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du a las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams na rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams na thugs kar gtod pa'i rin po che/ lcags kyu/ dbyug gu/ bum pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang / bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal zla ba'i dum bus dbu brgyan/ /brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma/ /ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las/ /rtag par shin tu 'od ni mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal bkra shis snang ba'i sgrol ma/ /sna tshogs padma zla ba'i gdan la/ /rdo rje skyil krung gser gyi mdangs ldan/ /zhal gcig phyag brgyad zla tshes brgyan ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas kyi dang po rtse gsum/ /gnyis pa na ni rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ /gsum pa rdo rjes bdud kyi dpung 'joms/ /bzhi pa shes rab ral gri bsnams ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon gyi dang po nor bu/

/longs spyod spel phyir thugs kar bsnams nas/ /'gro ba kun la bkra shis ster ma/ /gnyis pa lcags kyu gsum pa dbyug gu/ /bzhi pa nor gyi bum pa thogs ma/ /zhes so/ /bcu gsum pa yongs su smin pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la bhrūm̐ yig dmar po las sgrol ma dmar mo drag mo'i sku can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma/ /g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dga'i/ /dgra yi dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma/ /phyag 'tshal smin par byed pa'i sgrol ma/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na/ /padma dmar po nyi ma'i gdan la/ /bzhengs pa'i dor stabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums/ /phyag 'tshal sku mdog shin tu mi bzad/ /padma rā ga lta bur dmar zhing / /dpa' ba'i cha byad zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ /drag po chen mo bdud dpung 'joms ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yas kyi dang po ral gri/ /gnyis pa mda' yis nyon mongs 'bigs ma/ /g.yon pa 'khor lo gnyis pa gzhu thogs/ /mchu dang smin ma khros pas gyen bzlog /ces so/ /bcu bzhi pa khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar ser dang nyi ma/ ro'i steng du hūm̐ las sgrol ma khro gnyer can sku mdog mthing nag nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro gnyer bsdus pa/ mi'i rgyu ma zhal du gsol ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang / do shal can/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rin po che'i myu gu skyes pa zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gis/

/mthil gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis brdungs ma/ /khro gnyer can mdzad yi ge hūm̐ gis/ /rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma/ /phyag 'tshal khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma/ /padma nyi ma dmar ba'i gdan la/ /g.yas brkyangs gar gyis mi ro mnan ma/ /sku mdog stong zil 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ /phyag 'tshal zhal dang smin ma rab bsdus/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro gnyer dang ldan/ /dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig rab bgrad/ /mi yi rgyu ma zhal du gsol ma/ /phyag 'tshal sbrul dang stag gi lpags pa/ /thod pa'i cod paṇa mgo bo'i do shal/ /ral gri dbyug gu lcags kyu bsnams nas/ /g.yon pa thod zhags tshangs mgo 'dzin ma/ /zhes so/ /bco lnga pa bde legs zhi ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang zla ba la ṇi las sgrol ma zhi ba chen mo sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum phreng ba/ mchog sbyin/ dbyug pa/ g.yon gsum padmo/ ril ba spyi blugs/ padma'i steng na po ti 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma/ /mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma/ /swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan ma/ /sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal bde legs zhi ba'i sgrol ma/ /padma dkar po zla ba'i gdan la/ /rdo rje skyil krung kunda'i mdog can/ /zhal gcig phyag drug sdig pa 'joms ma/ /phyag 'tshal don rtogs g.yas kyi dang po/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yum thugs kar phreng 'dzin/ /gnyis pa legs pa'i phyag rgya mchog sbyin/ /gsum pa'i phyag gis dbyug gu 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon gyi dang po padma/ /gnyis pa na ni ril ba spyi blugs/ /gsum pa 'dab brgyad utpal steng na/ /'gro ba'i lam ston po ti bsnams ma/ /zhes so/ /bcu drug pa chags pa 'joms pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas pas thugs kar rtse gsum dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub 'phyar bas snying po dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i/ /dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma/ /yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ni bkod pa'i/ /rig pa hūm̐ las sgrol ma nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal chags pa 'joms pa'i sgrol ma/ /padma dmar ser nyi ma'i gdan la/ /spros med sems dpa'i skyil krung brjid mdzes/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum byu ru'i mdog can/ /phyag 'tshal hūm̐ gi rig pa dang ldan/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel gnyis/ /g.yas na rtse gsum thugs kar bsnams nas/ /dgra yi lus la rab tu bsnun ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon pas sdigs mdzub rab 'phyar/ /snying por bcas pa'i 'bras bu'i shing 'dzin/ /thugs kyi snying po yi ge bcu las/ /dgos pa'i dngos grub ma lus 'byung ma/ /zhes so/ /bcu bdun pa bde ba bsgrub pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dkar po nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las sgrol ma sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don grub/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal tu re'i zhabs ni brdabs pas/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma/ /ri rab manda ra dang 'bigs byed/ /'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal bde ba bsgrub pa'i sgrol ma/ /padma dkar po 'bar ba'i steng na/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i gdan la/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dpa' bar bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal bde ba'i sku mdog dmar ser/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis hūm̐ gi phrin las/ /'jig rten bdun po dbang du bsdus nas/ /bde ba thams cad sgrub par mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal thogs med nam mkha'i lus can/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu bsnams nas/ /rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis mdzes ma/

/zhes so/ /bco brgyad pa rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dkar po dang zla ba dang ngang pa'i steng du kaṃ las sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar bas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis mchog sbyin dang / utpal gyi steng na po ti bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i/ /ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma/ /tā ra gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi yi ges/ /dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma/ /padma dkar po'i steng na zla ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor dbus na 'dab bzang ngang pa'i/ /steng du sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal zag med bde ched rab rgyas/ /sku mdog dkar mo dung gi mdangs ldan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis tā ra gnyis brjod/ /phaṭa kyi yi ges dug rnams sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang ldan/ /phyag gnyis spyi bor lcags kyu rab 'dzin/ /g.yas 'og mchog sbyin g.yon gyi gnyis pa/ utpal steng na po ti bsnams pa/ /zhes so/ /bcu dgu pa sdug bsngal sreg pa'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan la tāṃ las rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar me thab bsnams ma/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs ba'i sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag rnam snang / bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po/ /lha dang mi'am ci yis bsten ma/ /kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis/ /rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal sdug bsngal sreg byed sgrol ma/ /pad dkar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng na/ /bde ba'i 'dug stangs sems dpa'i skyil krung / /cung zad g.yon brkyangs par ni bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal dkar mo kunda'i mdangs can/ /sna tshogs dkar dmar 'od zer phreng bas/ /'gyings bag sku la rab tu brgyan nas/

/'gro ba'i nyon mongs ma lus sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal bden gnyis dag pa'i phyag rgya/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar me thab bsnams nas/ /sdug bsngal ma lus sreg par mdzad cing / /'gro rnams thar pa'i lam la 'god ma/ /zhes so/ /nyi shu pa dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrol ma ni/ padma dkar po dang zla ba'i steng du tsa las rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar gser gyi bum pa 'dzin ma/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag don yod grub pa/ bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i/ /spyan gnyis po la 'od rab gsal ma/ /ha ra gnyis brjod tuttā ra yis/ /shin tu drag po'i rims nad sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal dngos grub 'byung gnas sgrol ma/ /sku mdog dmar ser las kyi rigs mtshon/ /padma dmar po'i steng na zla ba'i/ /dkyil du sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal dpa' mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ /thabs dang shes rab dag pa'i phyag rgya/ /thugs kar gser gyi bum pa bsnams te/ /dngos grub ma lus par ni ster ma/ /phyag 'tshal bum pa bzang dang nor bu/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing chen/ /khyod zhabs dran pas 'dod dgu 'byung 'gyur/ /gang la ci 'dod re ba skong ma/ /zhes so/ /nyer gcig pa yongs rdzogs byed pa'i sgrol ma ni/ ha las skyes pa'i khyu mchog gi steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ phe las rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo cung zad khro zhing spyan gsum ma rnam thar sgo gsum la gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas mdung rtse gsum dang g.yon mu tig gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thams can/ rigs bdag rin 'byung ngo / /bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pas/ /zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma/ /gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams/ /'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma/

/phyag 'tshal yongs su rdzogs byed sgrol ma/ /ha las skyes pa'i khyu mchog steng na/ /padma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gdan la/ /phyed skyil rol pa'i 'dug stangs brjid mdzes/ /phyag 'tshal dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo la gzigs ma/ /zhe sdang ma spangs gnas su dag phyir/ /dur khrod stag gi sham thabs bcings ma/ /phyag 'tshal g.yon na mu tig phreng 'dzin/ /thugs rjes mi bzad rab tu khros pas/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rtse gsum mdung thogs/ /dug gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu la bsnun ma/ /zhes bstod do/ /de ltar sgrol ma nyer gcig pa thams cad la rjes gnang gi dus sngags yi ge bcu pa 'ba'
